2609.35706.title: Reinforcing Agentic Creativity in Scientific Ideation with Night Science
2609.35706.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) excel at structured, verifiable tasks, but their low-entropy bias can produce homogeneous and predictable outputs, limiting their utility for open-ended scientific ideation. Effective discovery, however, spans a broader creative spectrum: from structured day science to loosely structured, serendipitous night science that reaches ideas beyond those typically considered. We introduce AI Night-Scientist, an agentic framework that uses reinforcement learning to teach models when and how to depart from predictable reasoning. Grounded in cognitive science, we model creativity along three axes: action (what to do and how creatively), process (when to explore versus exploit), and outcome (the novelty and usefulness of the resulting idea). We use these axes to train models with GRPO, exposing them to varying degrees and forms of creativity throughout training. This produces substantially more diverse scientific proposals, expanding the range of research directions by 27.8% and contribution types by 14.9% over the base model. It also improves predicted citation impact by up to 32.0 percentage points and originality by 66.2 points. These gains cannot be reproduced by simply increasing decoding temperature; instead, we find that semantic guidance specifying what kind of creativity to pursue is critical. Overall, our results suggest that creativity is a learnable, multi-level ability that can be shaped to help researchers reach ideas beyond those typically explored by LLMs.
2609.35706.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）在結構化、可驗證的任務中表現出色，但其低熵偏見可能產生同質且可預測的輸出，限制了它們在開放式科學構思中的效用。有效的發現則涵蓋了更廣泛的創造性範疇：從結構化的日間科學到鬆散結構的偶然夜間科學，這些科學觸及超出通常考慮的想法。我們介紹了 AI Night-Scientist，一個代理框架，使用強化學習來教導模型何時以及如何偏離可預測的推理。基於認知科學，我們沿著三個軸線來建模創造力：行動（該做什麼以及如何創造性地做）、過程（何時探索與利用）和結果（所產生想法的新穎性和實用性）。我們使用這些軸線來訓練模型，通過 GRPO，使它們在訓練過程中接觸不同程度和形式的創造力。這產生了顯著更多樣化的科學提案，將研究方向的範圍擴展了 27.8%，貢獻類型擴展了 14.9%，相較於基礎模型。它還將預測的引用影響提高了最多 32.0 個百分點，原創性提高了 66.2 分。這些增益無法僅通過提高解碼溫度來重現；相反，我們發現明確指導追求何種創造力的語義指導是至關重要的。總體而言，我們的結果表明，創造力是一種可學習的多層次能力，可以被塑造以幫助研究人員達到超出 LLMs 通常探索的想法。
